changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO case_definition_process_link (case_definition_key, case_definition_version_tag, process_definition_key, link_type) SELECT legacy.case_definition_key, cd.case_definition_version_tag, legacy.process_definition_key, legacy.link_type FROM case_definition_process_link legacy JOIN case_definition cd ON cd.case_definition_key = legacy.case_definition_key WHERE legacy.case_definition_version_tag IS NULL AND cd.case_definition_version_tag LIKE '%-migrated' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM case_definition_process_link existing WHERE existing.case_definition_key = cd.case_definition_key AND existing.case_definition_version_tag = cd.case_definition_version_tag AND (existing.link_type = legacy.link_type OR existing.process_definition_key = legacy.process_definition_key) )

changeSet.author: Ritense
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM case_definition_process_link WHERE case_definition_version_tag IS NULL
